intent: Write Sunday9:45arrival versus10:00event start and introduction purpose, repair singular schedule verbs and accept coherent so-that/in-order-to structures.
picturePurpose: Exact coded time-role, sentence-repair and purpose-structure cards keep schedule facts separate from alternative written forms.

workshop.title: 把到场时间与提前的目的写清楚
workshop.instruction: 周日九点四十五到场，十点活动开始。先把两件事分别写准确，再用so that或in order to解释提前听介绍的目的。原题没有限定一定是换书活动。

items.label: 活动begins，志愿者arrive
items.prompt: 哪句把两个时间与主语对应准确？
items.reason: 时间角色与主谓形式已核对。接下来把提前介绍的目的写清楚。
items.hint: the event是单数，可以说begins；volunteers是复数，arrive不加s。也可以用will begin/will arrive等准确说法，不要求整段套一种时态。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。周日志愿活动十点开始，你要九点四十五到场听介绍。向同伴说明到场时间和原因。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 主语 ↔ 时间 ↔ 动词
composeBrief.hint: 这张卡练习用一般现在时介绍日程，再补上志愿者到场安排。
composeBrief.wrong: 原题活动十点开始、志愿者九点四十五到场；不能互换。The event是单数，用begins，不用begin或beginning单独作谓语。

fields.label: 哪句保留原题两件事的时间？

choices.label: The event begins at ten, but volunteers should arrive at nine forty-five.
The event begins at nine forty-five, but volunteers should arrive at ten.
The event and volunteer arrival are both at ten.

fields.label: 用一般现在时修复 The event begin at ten.

choices.label: The event begins at ten.
The event begin at ten.
The event beginning at ten.

items.label: 两种目的表达，结构要跟着换
items.prompt: 选so that或in order to，再配上结构准确的句子。
items.reason: 目的与所选结构已配好。自己的稿子也可以用其他准确自然的表达。
items.hint: so that后接完整句子we understand ...；in order to后接动词原形understand ...。两种都可解释提前听介绍是为了了解分工，不把目的写成介绍只给访客听。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。周日志愿活动十点开始，你要九点四十五到场听介绍。向同伴说明到场时间和原因。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: so that ↔ in order to
composeBrief.hint: 换连接方式时，也要检查后面接的是完整句子还是动词原形。
composeBrief.wrong: 两个正确示例都可以，但要与所选结构一致。so that后接we understand这样的完整句子；in order to后接动词原形understand，不能再接we understand。两种都说明了解分工的目的。

choices.label: so that +完整句子
in order to +动词原形
We need the introduction so that we understand our roles before the event begins.
We need the introduction in order to understand our roles before the event begins.
We need the introduction in order to we understand our roles.

items.label: 日期、分工目的与书面形式都保留
items.prompt: 交稿前核对：周日、提前了解分工、2—4句英文。
items.reason: 日期、目的与写作形式已核对。实际完成自己的2—4句英文，检查时间有没有前后颠倒。
items.hint: 九点四十五比十点早十五分钟，但不代表介绍一定持续十五分钟。原题要求说明到场时间和原因，不必添加没有给出的介绍时长或活动地点。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。周日志愿活动十点开始，你要九点四十五到场听介绍。向同伴说明到场时间和原因。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 交稿前核对卡
composeBrief.hint: 先核对事实与原因，再检查完整句子和标点。
composeBrief.wrong: 原题是周日；9:45到场听介绍，是为了了解分工，不是改变10:00的活动开始时间。15分钟的间隔不能证明介绍恰好持续15分钟。本题写2—4句完整英文，只列数字或只交口头提纲都不够。

choices.label: Sunday
Saturday
Monday

fields.label: 哪句保留提前听介绍的目的？

choices.label: Understand our roles before the event begins.
Change the public start time to nine forty-five.
Prove that the introduction lasts exactly fifteen minutes.
Two to four written English sentences giving arrival time and the reason.
Only the numbers 9:45 and 10:00.
Only a spoken plan without written sentences.

transfer.stem: 周五下午活动14:30开始，志愿者14:10到场听介绍、了解分工。哪段书面回答分清了两个时间，并说明了提前的目的？
transfer.passage:
A different written volunteer reminder
On Friday afternoon, an event begins at 2:30. Volunteers should arrive at 2:10 for an introduction so they understand their roles before the event. Write two to four English sentences explaining arrival time and the reason. The exact introduction length is not given.

options.text: The event begins at 2:10 on Friday afternoon. Volunteers should arrive at 2:30. We need the introduction so that we understand our roles.
The event begins at 2:30 on Friday afternoon. Volunteers should arrive at 2:10. We need the introduction so that we understand our roles before the event begins.
The event begins at ten on Sunday. Volunteers should arrive at nine forty-five. We need the introduction so that we understand our roles.
The event begins at 2:30 on Friday afternoon. Volunteers should arrive at 2:10. We should come early only to choose front-row seats and take photographs.

answer.display: The event begins at 2:30 on Friday afternoon. Volunteers should arrive at 2:10. We need the introduction so that we understand our roles before the event begins.

explanation.strategy: 先更新新题日期与两个时间，再用完整句子写清提前到场的目的。

steps.text: 新安排是周五下午：两点十分到场，两点半活动开始。
steps.reason: 到场与开始不能互换，也不能照搬周日旧安排。

steps.text: 提前听介绍是为了在活动前了解分工。
steps.reason: 可以用so that或in order to等准确结构说明目的；只写对时间或换成别的目的，都没有完整回应任务。

distractors.reason: 把到场与活动开始时间互换。
没有更新新日期与时间。
时间虽然对应正确，却把提前的目的改成选座拍照，没有说明听介绍、了解分工。

explanation.pitfall: 两个时间都写了，却没有交代哪个是到场，哪个是开始，或漏掉提前的原因。

visual.title: Friday · 2:10到场 → 2:30开始
visual.caption: 句式可换，时间与目的不能换；介绍准确时长未给出。

explanation.transfer: 把同一个目的分别接在so that和in order to后，主语与动词形式需要怎样调整？
